scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.check:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/mobile
scripts.test:web: npm run test:smoke --workspace apps/web && npm run check:i18n --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:server: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace server
scripts.check:foundation: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run test --workspace server
